text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Giving it everything she had, Sweep Tosho 
engaged in a fierce battle that sent waves 
of excitement through the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her classmate was completely captivated by 
Sweep Tosho, and Tokai Teio narrowed her 
eyes slightly in frustration... yet 
happily.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Sweep Tosho earned Tokai Teio's 
acknowledgment, being told that her 
running had brought excitement to 
everyone.
